caseNameFull: Roman, Clerk of the Peace v. Sincock
attorneys: David P. Buckson, Attorney General of Delaware, E. Norman Veasey, Chief Deputy Attorney General, Frederick Bernays Wiener, Januar D. Bove, Jr., Frank O’Donnell and N. Maxson Terry for appellants. Vincent A. Theisen for appellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the District of Delaware. Probable jurisdiction noted. The motion to advance is granted and the case is set for argument on Monday, December 9, 1963. The printing of the record is dispensed with. The brief of the appellants shall be filed on or before November 9th and the brief of the appellees shall be filed on or before November 29th.
